De Coelesti Hierarchia
De Coelesti Hierarchia
(
Ancient Greek
:
Περὶ τῆς Οὐρανίας Ἱεραρχίας
,
romanized
:
Peri tēs Ouraníās Hierarchíās
, "On the Celestial Hierarchy") is a
Pseudo-Dionysian
work on
angelology
, written in
Greek
and dated to ca. AD the 5th century; it exerted great influence on
scholasticism
and treats at great length the
hierarchies of angels
.
